b2-guatemala-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Built Temple I?
b2-guatemala-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about Tikal, and he asks you what you learned about Temple I.
b2-guatemala-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what was built over the ruler's tomb.
cues: Say that a temple was built
Say that it was built over a ruler's tomb
b2-guatemala-01.target: El Templo I fue levantado sobre la tumba de un gobernante.
b2-guatemala-01.english: Temple I was built over a ruler's tomb.
b2-guatemala-01.canDo: I can say who built or did something with *ser* + participle + *por*.

b2-guatemala-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Twins of the Popol Vuh
b2-guatemala-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You have read about the Popol Vuh and you tell Meg what happened to the twins.
b2-guatemala-02.prompt: Tell Meg what the twins did after defeating the lords of Xibalbá.
cues: Say that the twins defeated the lords of Xibalbá
Say that afterwards they went up to the sky
b2-guatemala-02.target: Después de vencer a los señores de Xibalbá, los gemelos subieron al cielo.
b2-guatemala-02.english: After defeating the lords of Xibalbá, the twins went up to the sky.
b2-guatemala-02.canDo: I can say what came first and what came next with *antes de* and *después de* + infinitive.

b2-guatemala-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Thick Walls in Antigua
b2-guatemala-03.scenario: You are Meg. You are planning a trip to Antigua with Carlos and you tell him what you read about its churches.
b2-guatemala-03.prompt: Tell Carlos that the churches had thick walls but were still damaged.
cues: Say that the walls were very thick
Say that many buildings were damaged anyway
b2-guatemala-03.target: A pesar de que los muros eran muy gruesos, muchos edificios sufrieron daños.
b2-guatemala-03.english: Although the walls were very thick, many buildings suffered damage.
b2-guatemala-03.canDo: I can say that something happened in spite of a difficulty, with *a pesar de que* and *pese a*.

b2-guatemala-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Commission Said
b2-guatemala-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You are reading about the armed conflict in Guatemala and you tell Meg what the Commission for Historical Clarification said.
b2-guatemala-04.prompt: Tell Meg what the CEH said about the number of dead and disappeared.
cues: Say that the commission said something
Say how many people had died or disappeared, according to the CEH
b2-guatemala-04.target: La comisión dijo que unas doscientas mil personas habían muerto o desaparecido.
b2-guatemala-04.english: The commission said that about two hundred thousand people had died or disappeared.
b2-guatemala-04.canDo: I can report what someone said, with *dijo que* and the verb moved back in time.

b2-guatemala-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Serves the Cantones?
b2-guatemala-05.scenario: You are Meg. You are writing a short article about the 48 Cantones of Totonicapán and you tell Carlos what their representatives say.
b2-guatemala-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what the representatives say about their authorities and their salary.
cues: Say that you are citing the representatives
Say that the authorities serve without a salary
b2-guatemala-05.target: Según sus representantes, las autoridades de los cantones sirven sin recibir un sueldo.
b2-guatemala-05.english: According to their representatives, the authorities of the cantons serve without receiving a salary.
b2-guatemala-05.canDo: I can say who does or grows something with *ser* + participle + *por*.

b2-guatemala-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Planning a Trip to Guatemala
b2-guatemala-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are planning a trip, and you tell her what you want to do after reading about Guatemala.
b2-guatemala-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what you want to do after reading about Tikal and Antigua.
cues: Say that you will read about Tikal and Antigua first
Say that you want to travel to Guatemala afterwards
b2-guatemala-consolidation.target: Después de leer sobre Tikal y Antigua, quiero viajar a Guatemala.
b2-guatemala-consolidation.english: After reading about Tikal and Antigua, I want to travel to Guatemala.
b2-guatemala-consolidation.canDo: I can review what I learned about Guatemala, from Tikal to the highlands today.
